checks.name: actual-optional-rules-provider

checks.name: Queen-lock-physical-Female-consumed

checks.name: unselected-deck-records-intact

checks.name: first-pending-consumed

checks.name: bonus-setup-hides-forbidden-categories

checks.name: bonus-category-authorized
checks.details: Compare actual consumed category to first physical action, not assumed plan/cursor.

checks.name: bonus-one-consumption

checks.name: bonus-ledger-matches-actions
checks.details: Real Dual accounting matches definitive categories.

checks.name: bonus-instance-conservation

checks.name: bonus-pending-consumed

checks.name: HAL23-normal-controller-consumes-pending
checks.details: No artificial UI window or mid-planner activation. This is a synchronous native controller call, not Windows UI proof.
